title.zh: Nvidia is the central bank of AI
title.en: Nvidia is the central bank of AI

current_state.zh: The Economist argues Nvidia has become the de facto central bank of the AI economy through its scale, capital commitments, and influence over compute markets, prompting discussion of financial engineering, GPU depreciation, and hyperscaler rivalry.
